items.information: ![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://i.imgur.com/jmSpkQE.png) ## IMPORTANT: This competition is happening on a weekday, not a weekend * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. * Competitors may only bring one guest maximum.
